messages:
maria (Design): Hey folks — quick accessibility review request for the new Models table side panel.

maria (Design): Main concerns: low contrast on selected row, focus ring looks subtle on dark theme, keyboard nav skips the expand chevron sometimes. Screenshot: /assets/xxx (see panel)

kevin (Eng): Thanks. Reproduced locally. The selection uses `#5A6A7B` on `#FFFFFF` (light) and `#3A3F45` on `#0B0C0D` (dark). I'll push a branch to try stronger contrast.

sam (A11y): TL;DR: contrast fail on selection + non-consistent focus outline. Also aria-live announcement missing when row expands. Screen reader (VoiceOver) reads "row, 3 of 5" but doesn't announce expanded content.

ria (PM): Priority? Customers hit this in beta demos yesterday.

maria (Design): High priority for GA. Can we ship a patch that improves focus + SR announce and follow with a deeper keyboard flow pass?

kevin (Eng): Plan: 1) bump selection bg colors, 2) add `:focus-visible` 2px solid outline (`#0A84FF` on light, `#79AFFF` on dark), 3) ensure `tabindex=0` on row and chevron separate so each is reachable. I'll open PR.

sam (A11y): Also add `aria-expanded` on the chevron button and move the expanded panel content into an `aria-live="polite"` container with `role="region"` and `aria-label="details for <model-name>"` so screen readers announce it when content appears.

olga (QA): Quick test matrix I can run: VoiceOver + NVDA on Windows, keyboard only (tab/shift-tab/enter/space), focus order snap, and color contrast with accessible colors. I can verify once PR link is up.

kevin (Eng): Pushed draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4287 — CSS tweaks + small JS to move node into live region. Notes in PR.

maria (Design): Review: Focus visible is better. A couple of copy nits in `aria-label` — use "Model details" not just "details". Also reduce the visual jump when inline expands (animate height) to avoid focus loss.

sam (A11y): Minor nit: when animating height, keep `overflow: hidden` and don't remove `tabindex` from inner controls during animation. If controls are focusable while offscreen it causes weird SR chatter. For conservative approach, wait to set `aria-hidden=false` until animation completes.

kevin (Eng): Good call. I'll gate `aria-hidden` toggle with `transitionend` and add `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback.

ria (PM): ETA for merge?

kevin (Eng): Aiming EOD today. If QA signs off tomorrow morning, we can include in next patch release.

olga (QA): Will start tests once CI passes. I'll post results in thread.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline for PR 4287 passed all checks — snapshot diff flagged the new focus ring but approved visually.

maria (Design): Thanks team! After merge, let's add a short prod test script to the console e2e that covers keyboard nav for panels so this doesn't regress.

sam (A11y): I'll add a short checklist to the a11y handbook too: contrast values, `aria-expanded` semantics, live region pattern for in-panel content.

kevin (Eng): Noted. Closing loop after QA.
